items.title: The Nike Mind 001 Sets Its Moving Nodes in Chocolate Brown for "Palomino"
items.summary:
Name: Nike Mind 001 “Palomino”
 Colorway: Palomino/Tar-Metallic Platinum
 SKU: HQ4307-201
 MSRP: $95 USD
 Release Date: Spring 2027

The Nike Mind 001 "Palomino" is set to give one of Nike's more experimental silhouettes an earthy update, with a palette built from olive, brown and flashes of metallic platinum. According to early details, the build is focused on how the shoe connects you to the ground, and Nike frames the design around feeling every surface and staying aware of each step.

From the side, olive does most of the work. It covers much of the profile and continues down to the wavy edge of the sole, while brown tones take over higher on the upper. A perforated panel in light brown runs from the collar almost to the toe and carries a small metallic silver Swoosh in its center. A second Swoosh stands upright on the outside of the molded shell for a bolder branding moment.

The outsole is where the Mind 001 stands apart. Twenty-two chocolate brown nodes are spread across the bottom, and each one moves on its own as you walk, so the sole adjusts to whatever is under it instead of acting as one rigid platform. That setup is central to Nike's pitch for the shoe, which centers on ground feel and a more deliberate stride.

Nike also adds a playful detail inside. The footbeds don't match: one carries "Nike Mind" in white lettering, and the other reads "Mind Science Department," which points back to the research-lab theme behind the line.

Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops .

items.t: The Nike Mind 001 Sets Its Moving Nodes in Chocolate Brown for "Palomino"

items.title: Panini Turns ‘GTA VI's’ In-Game Collectibles Into a Real Sports Trading Card Collection
items.summary:
Summary 

Panini America and Rockstar Games are releasing the ‘GTA VI’ Sports Trading Card Collection, their first trading card tie-in for the gameThe officially licensed set turns the collectible cards found inside ‘GTA VI’ into physical cardsParallels range from Special Silver, Pink, Teal and Light Blue up to numbered Legend Bronze, Silver and 1-of-1 Gold cards

Panini America and Rockstar Games are launching the GTA VI Sports Trading Card Collection, a licensed set that takes the card collectibles players chase in Grand Theft Auto VI and puts them into physical packs. It's the first trading card partnership built around the game, so collectors can open real packs of the same cards that show up in-game .

Each box holds four packs and is built to give a predictable spread of base hits. On average, a box yields two Rookies, one Retro and one Illustrated card, plus four Special Silvers, so every rip covers the set's main card styles. With the Rookies, Retros and Illustrated cards working as distinct subsets, collectors have a clear checklist to work through before the parallel hunt begins.

The parallels are where the chase gets serious. Beyond Special Silver, the set comes in Pink, Teal and Light Blue versions for collectors building rainbows. The numbered tiers then narrow quickly: Legend Bronze is limited to 49 copies, Silver drops to 25, and the Gold parallels are true 1-of-1s, making them the hardest cards in the set to pull.

The GTA VI Sports Trading Card Collection from Panini America and Rockstar Games is set to release in December 2026.

items.title: Lil Uzi Vert Weaves a Rainbow of Thread Into the Vans Authentic 44 "Pink Cosmos"
items.summary:
Name: Lil Uzi Vert x Vans Authentic 44 “Pink Cosmos”
 Colorway: Pink/Multi-Color
 SKU: VN0010WY3TD
 MSRP: TBC
 Release Date: Holiday 2026

Lil Uzi Vert 's Vans Authentic 44 "Pink Cosmos" is reportedly set to close out the year, giving one of the label's most pared-back silhouettes a heavily textured finish. The pair arrives as the rapper steps back into the spotlight with new music, so his latest era comes with footwear to match.

The upper is made from a dense weave of multicolored threads. So many shades are packed in that the surface reads as tactile rather than printed, and it changes depending on how close you look. Pink is the loudest of the bunch, and it doesn't stay in the weave. It runs onto the eyelets and wraps the ankle collar, so the colorway holds together from toe to heel.

Branding is kept to a few deliberate touches, which leaves most of the work to the woven upper. Inside, the insole carries a Vans logo with a " By Lil Uzi Vert " credit tucked underneath. A second Vans logo on the heel bumper anchors the back of the shoe.

That restraint suits a silhouette that has always been about simplicity. The Authentic began as Style 44, the canvas deck shoe the Van Doren Rubber Company sold when it opened in Anaheim, California, in 1966. Skaters later adopted it for its grippy waffle outsole, and that makes 2026 the model's 60th year. A woven, pink-forward reading of it is a deliberate departure from the plain canvas the shoe built its name on.

The pink is no accident either. The color has become a calling card for Uzi, most visibly through his 2023 album Pink…
items.t: Lil Uzi Vert Weaves a Rainbow of Thread Into the Vans Authentic 44 "Pink Cosmos"

items.title: Apple Is Reportedly Planning an M6 MacBook Air Refresh for Spring 2027 Ahead of an OLED Redesign
items.summary:
Summary 

Apple is preparing a dual-phase rollout for the MacBook Air, starting with an M6 chip update in spring 2027The initial launch will be a straightforward spec refresh, arriving alongside the new MacBook Neo 2A major design overhaul featuring an OLED display is slated to follow in late 2027 or 2028

During a Thanksgiving mailbag episode of his Power On podcast , Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman fielded a listener Q&A segment that laid out the immediate roadmap for Apple ’s most popular laptop. Titled "Mailbag: Mark Answers Your Questions About Apple’s Product & Political Future," the episode detailed major two-part release plans for the MacBook Air . According to Gurman, Apple is planning to launch new 13-inch and 15-inch iterations of the machine in spring 2027. Developed internally under the project codenames J913 and J915, these forthcoming models will officially introduce Apple's M6 chip to the lightweight laptop line. However, the spring drop isn't meant to reinvent the wheel. Gurman specifically described this spring 2027 release as a straightforward "chip and ship" refresh that brings minimal hardware changes to the table.

When these M6-powered MacBook Air models hit the market, they are scheduled to launch right alongside an entirely new device known as the MacBook Neo 2. But while the internals are getting a performance boost, the exterior of the current generation is rapidly aging out. Gurman noted on the podcast that the current MacBook Air aesthetic is nearing the "end of the road." Apple originally introduced this specific industrial design language back…
items.t: Apple Is Reportedly Planning an M6 MacBook Air Refresh for Spring 2027 Ahead of an OLED Redesign

items.title: Maison Kitsuné and Paraboot Rework the Classic Chambord for Fall/Winter 2026
items.summary:
Summary 

Maison Kitsuné and Paraboot reunite to reinterpret the classic Chambord derby.Glossy brown leather pairs with white contrast stitching and asymmetrical logo tabs.Priced at approx. $670 USD, it launches November 28 in limited quantities.

Name: Maison Kitsuné x Paraboot “Chambord”
 Colorway: Brown
 SKU: TBC
 MSRP: ¥106,700 JPY (approx. $670 USD)
 Release Date: November 28
 Where to Buy: Maison Kitsuné 

Maison Kitsuné and Paraboot have reunited for their second footwear collaboration. First previewed as part of Maison Kitsuné’s Fall/Winter 2026 collection, the release sees the duo reinterpret Paraboot’s signature Chambord derby, taking the French brand’s silhouette and reframing it through a casual preppy lens.

Built around the Chambord’s rounded U-tip paneling, the shoe uses glossy brown leather rich with tonal shading. Crisp white stitching traces the contours and runs across the upper at a 45-degree angle, sharpening the silhouette’s three-dimensional form against the deep-toned hide. The defining touch sits on the side: Paraboot’s signature green tag is split asymmetrically across the pair, placing the shoemaker’s logo on the right foot and Maison Kitsuné’s fox emblem on the left.

Rather than reinventing the wheel, the two labels opted to highlight heritage craftsmanship and designed the shoe to blend naturally into everyday outfits. Offered in limited quantities, the shoe launches November 28 via Maison Kitsuné’s online store and select Japanese locations.

items.title: Y-3 and Jeff Hamilton Celebrate Kimi Antonelli’s First F1 Title With a Bespoke Jacket
items.summary:

Y-3 and Jeff Hamilton create a custom jacket for Kimi Antonelli’s first F1 Drivers' World Champion title.The quilted black piece features stripes, Italian accents, and championship graphics.Made exclusively for Antonelli, the bespoke tribute won’t release publicly.

Marking a defining milestone in Kimi Antonelli ’s career, Y-3 and Jeff Hamilton have unveiled a one-of-one jacket created exclusively for the driver to celebrate his first Formula 1 Drivers’ World Championship win with the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team .

Turning his achievement into a wearable trophy, the custom piece arrives in a sleek black quilted silhouette with a structured hood, featuring bold contrasting white stripes down the sleeves alongside checkered detailing. Co-branded Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team and Y-3 logos sit cleanly across the chest, while personalized touches — including red “ANTONELLI” lettering and the Italian tricolor flag along the sleeve — serve as a direct nod to the champion’s heritage. A prominent “2026 F1 World Champion” graphic spans the back, placing his win squarely at the center of the design.

Built purely as a personal tribute to Antonelli’s championship-winning season, the bespoke jacket is not slated for a public release. Take a closer look at the piece in the gallery above.

The Moncler x Rick Owens Fall/Winter 2026 collection is built around outerwear. It brings Owens' subversive eye together with the Italian house's background in warm, protective technical gear. The two labels have shaped each other's work over time, and this season puts that exchange into a run of quilted pieces in a wide range of shapes.

Quilting is the collection's backbone. A graphic Geo Quilting pattern breaks up the surfaces into sharp, architectural sections, so even the simpler shapes have an edge. Owens' hardware sits on top: metal studs run along the outerwear, and oversized Tour pockets add real storage without diluting the look.

It's a large carrying strap that lets you sling a jacket over your shoulder or across your body when you've taken it off, so heavy layers don't have to be either worn or left behind. items.title: Porsche Brings Mid-Engine DNA to the EV Era With the All-Electric 718 Boxster
items.summary:
Summary 

Porsche’s first all-electric 718 Boxster debuts in Q1 2027.Bespoke E-Core architecture and 911 hardware preserve mid-engine balance.The rear-wheel-drive flagship hits 60 mph in under three seconds with simulated seven-speed shifts.

Porsche is nearing the finish line with its first all-electric two-door sports car, confirming that the production-ready 718 Boxster will make its world premiere in the first quarter of 2027 following nearly 2.5 million miles of endurance testing across more than 20 countries. 

Structurally, the 718 Boxster utilizes a bespoke E-Core architecture designed to preserve classic sports car proportions. Mounting its 800-volt battery directly behind the seats allows the car to retain a low seating position and a traditional 40:60 front-to-rear weight distribution, while lightweight construction keeps overall weight similar to the current 911 Cabriolet T-Hybrid. Underneath, the roadster borrows heavily from its big brother, the 911, with Carrera GTS-based steering, 911-derived brakes, an electronically controlled PTV+ limited-slip differential, and rear-axle steering—available on the 718 Boxster for the first time. 

The all-electric 718 Boxster will be the most powerful 718 ever, exclusively featuring rear-wheel drive. The flagship variant accelerates from 0 to 60 mph in under three seconds and reaches a top track speed in excess of 155 mph. Standard E-Shift technology adds an analog feel back into the driving experience by simulating a seven-speed PDK transmission with automatic or paddle-operated shifts, accompanied by the familiar…
items.t: Porsche Brings Mid-Engine DNA to the EV Era With the All-Electric 718 Boxster

items.title: ESOTERIC THING Releases First Drop of Winter 2026 Collection
items.summary:
Shanghai streetwear brand ESOTERIC THING has officially released Drop 1 of its Winter 2026 collection. Drawing inspiration from classic streetwear elements, the brand presents a bold and direct winter street style through the collision of portrait photography prints, highly saturated camouflage, animal textures, and comic patterns.

The collection covers a variety of apparel and accessory pieces, with portrait photography prints running through T-shirts and pullover hoodies, paired with cargo pants made from distressed flocked fabric for a gritty street texture. The visually recognizable pink camouflage is presented in fleece and extends to hooded jackets, cropped shorts, and trucker hats, injecting a more distinct color expression into traditional military camouflage.

In addition, the collection applies snake-print faux fur to jackets, reversible leather vests, and trapper hats, enriching winter layering with exaggerated textures and different material combinations. Allover comic-style jacquard patterns run through knitwear pieces such as pullover sweaters, scarves, and beanies, further enhancing the visual tension of the overall look.

Drop 1 of the ESOTERIC THING Winter 2026 collection will officially land on the brand's official online store and website on November 27.

items.title: 24 Hours with Red Bull during Latin Music’s Busiest Week
items.summary:
Red Bull kept the energy flowing as Hypebeast LATAM returned to Las Vegas during Latin GRAMMY Week . From an exclusive interview suite at the Encore Tower Suites to dinner at Zero Bond, an after-hours celebration at Disco Bébé and a five-kilometer morning run, the brand joined a packed schedule that stretched from early morning interviews to late-night performances.

Inside Hypebeast LATAM's three-bedroom suite, Red Bull fueled a steady rotation of interviews. Alongside its signature Energy Drink, the brand introduced its Winter Edition Pistachio and Berries, bringing an unexpected pairing of nutty and fruity notes to the week's lineup.
That flavor followed the celebrations to Hypebeast LATAM's Zero Bond dinner. Served alongside fresh seafood, crispy rice appetizers, and rich chocolate desserts, Red Bull Winter Edition Pistachio and Berries took on cocktail duty, mixed with spirits and finished with fresh citrus.

When dinner wrapped, the night went straight into Disco Bébé, Hypebeast LATAM's after-hours celebration. Red Bull stayed on hand as some of Latin music's biggest names took the stage for exclusive performances, carrying the party well past midnight.

The following morning, Red Bull picked up the pace as more than 80 guests gathered for a five-kilometer run. A monstrous Red Bull truck supplied the soundtrack at the starting point, while chilled cans helped kick off the early call time. items.title: Infinix Packs Its ZClip 2 Pro Earbuds Into a Snack Bag
items.summary:
The Infinix ZClip 2 Pro comes in a foil snack pouch, a form familiar to all. Tear the notched edge, hear the crinkle, and instead of chips you get a pair of metallic open-ear earbuds.

The ZClip 2 Pro ships in air-filled foil pouches modeled on real snack packaging. The thinking is simple. Snacks and earbuds are two of the easiest everyday escapes, so Infinix put one inside the other and turned unboxing into a small reward ritual. Infinix calls it "Snack Aesthetics," and for a social-first generation that shares everything it opens. Where the industry keeps packaging quiet and serious, Infinix makes it loud and playful. The brand brings a sense of delight to everyday tech products through fun packaging and unboxing experiences.

Each foil pouch is fronted by one of three art-toy characters, blending distinct style personas with playful snack pairings. The Streetwise Gorilla, wearing a street jersey and gold chains, channels the bold, loud crunch of spicy chips. The High-Fashion Black Rabbit wears a dark leather jacket, evoking the smooth bite of premium dark chocolate. Finally, the Laid-back Sheep pairs vintage leather with retro shades, matching the relaxed comfort of a classic sweet puff. Beyond driving the packaging's visual style, their distinct features: the gorilla's human-like ears, the rabbit's tall points, and the sheep's floppy drop, demonstrate what Infinix calls its universal "All-Ear Fit."

The pouch is only the first step. The same idea carries through the whole campaign, built around "Clip on, drift away". Opening a snack and clipping on a pair of earbuds…
items.t: Infinix Packs Its ZClip 2 Pro Earbuds Into a Snack Bag

The Tulum jungle in Mexico has been integral to Zamna ’s rise, hosting its first music festival back in 2017. Though the culture and hospitality group has taken the festival to over 20 countries since its inception, it returns to its roots for Zamna’s 10th anniversary with a special 10-day line-up in the ancient area. 

Teasing global festival-goers, Zamna launched a commemorative film last week, which captured celebrations from the last decade. From high-octane sets by renowned DJs Peggy Gou and David Guetta to theatrical productions that gave a stage to Tale Of Us, Rüfüs du Sol , and Gorillaz , the visuals traced iconic moments that fed off the “land, culture and history” to shape a festival that connects people and platforms dance music. 

For the upcoming 10th anniversary event, the group continues to cement itself as a global destination for dance culture. Turning the programming up a notch, the schedule kicks off on New Year’s Eve with a takeover from British electronic music platform RENAISSANCE . After welcoming Sasha, Maceo Plex, and Ida Engberg to the festival, Amnesia makes its Zamna debut, bringing a piece of Ibiza to Mexico for its own milestone anniversary. Other curated line-ups include ANYMA ’s Berlin club night ÆDEN, Adriatique ’s X, and Black Coffee , culminating with a special showcase from Adam Port of Keinemusik .

items.title: They’re bringing sexy back – but this time it’s classy | Jess Cartner-Morley
items.summary:
From a V-neck sweater worn back-to-front to a perfectly framed collarbone – here’s the secret to low-stakes sex appeal

I’m not sure when it started being not chic to want to look sexy, but it’s definitely a thing and it bothers me as it doesn’t feel truthful to the human experience, if that’s not a lot for the first sentence of a fashion column. Our wardrobes have become shrines to good taste. Well-cut coats and quality knitwear, elegant flat shoes and crisp white shirts. These clothes are excellent at communicating that you have read the briefing notes for the meeting and have some Booker prize chat. They are less good at suggesting you might be up for dancing on a table later.

Why do we have to choose? Clothes have always been partly about how they make us feel physically. We accept that an outfit can make you feel powerful, cool, smart. Why shouldn’t it also make you feel hot and fun?

items.title: Children of the revolution: how the north of England is defining modern men’s fashion
items.summary:
Once the historic centre of the textile industry, the north is now home to a host of a provenance-driven labels. But is there a specific northern menswear look? And what does it all mean for the mad-fer-it stereotypes?

In 2026, clothing has proved more important to Andy Burnham’s political identity than that of any British prime minister since Margaret Thatcher. He is a loyal Clarks and Adidas wearer, whose Howick worker’s jacket hangs in Manchester’s People’s History Museum. His ousting of Keir Starmer – launched shortly before being photographed jogging in a replica Everton shirt – has been memorialised as the “casual coup”. In one telling, the reason for this is simple: he’s a man from the north.

That Burnham is the first born-and-bred northern male PM since Harold Wilson last swished his Gannex raincoat out of Downing Street goes some way to explaining his higher interest in clothing. It’s not necessarily that all men in the south care less about clothing, or that all men in the north do – but that many men from the north express it in such a distinctive, even unified, way.

items.title: Brioche armchairs, butter sculptures and edible chandeliers: meet the new food artists
items.summary:
Culinary artists are turning fashion shows and design fairs into a feast for the eyes

A pretty Venetian chandelier featuring delicate pink flowers and cascading blue leaves hangs from a ceiling. A hazy, warm light radiates from its tulip bulbs. Suddenly, a woman reaches up and snaps off one of the flower stems, giggling as she begins to nibble it. Welcome to the weird and wonderful world of Laila Gohar. The Egyptian-born, New York-based artist is part of a new wave of culinary artists blurring the lines between sustenance and spectacle, and this troupe have quickly become a firm fixture at fashion parties and design fairs, turning dining into a phenomenon and delight.

Gohar describes the chandelier, made entirely from hand-spun sugar (including the silver chain that suspended it) as her “favourite thing she has done in recent history”. It joins a long list of extravagant yet still edible installations she has created, including lifesize armchairs made of brioche, an entire room constructed with Belgian chocolate and a four-metre-long mortadella that had to be lifted into the party’s venue using a crane.
